_comment: enabled:false = kill switch (compose, publish nothing). mode:draft = Buffer drafts for review / live = schedule for real. research_per_day = target AI-trend posts per day, EACH cross-posted to every channel in `channels` (raise this digit to scale up; the quality gate still applies). linkedin_format = 'carousel' means EVERY LinkedIn post ships as a carousel PDF deck (not a single image), so with research_per_day=N you get N LinkedIn carousels/day, one per research topic (currently 1) — see config/carousel.md; 'auto' restores the old conditional (carousel only for breakdowns). X always uses a single image (no native carousel). skip_days = weekday abbrevs (UTC) to NOT post on (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun). posting_windows_utc = ordered list of 'HH:MM-HH:MM' UTC windows the routine schedules dueAt into (Step 8); currently ['04:00-05:00','15:00-17:00'] = 9-10am & 8-10pm Pakistan time (PKT=UTC+5). The 00:30 UTC run fills the FIRST window (morning), the 12:30 UTC run the SECOND (evening); SAME windows for X and LinkedIn, each post a random independent minute inside. Edit these to retime posts — no routine-prompt change needed. The Ployo diary routine separately posts 1 diary/day to these same channels. product_spotlight = a SECOND content stream (separate from research_per_day): a builder's-lens take on a notable NEW PRODUCT launch (Product Hunt / Show HN). enabled = on/off; run = which daily run produces it ('second' = the 12:30 UTC run only); linkedin_max_per_week = hard cap on product-spotlight LinkedIn carousels per ISO week (X is daily, uncapped). Full rules + the builder's-lens framing (never a thumbs-up/down verdict, never dunk on the makers) live in config/product-spotlight.md. takes = a THIRD stream (X-only, TEXT-only): one of Ahmed's pre-approved strongest opinions from state/opinion-bank.json, developed into a standalone long-form X post (no image/link/thread, never LinkedIn). enabled = on/off; per_day = max takes/UTC-day (start 1; bump to 2 AND set run:'any' to scale); run = which run fires it ('first' = 00:30 UTC run -> morning window, 'second' = 12:30, 'any' = both). Full rules in config/takes.md; the bank is hand-edited by Ahmed, the routine only updates last_used/times_used.
